understanding.summary: The current product has a strong local-first workflow architecture, a coherent Studio and unusually broad contract coverage. The audit reproduced four delivery/runtime defects, two public-product-truth defects, one accessibility defect and two evidence gaps. All locally solvable findings are selected for this iteration; a risky beta dependency migration remains deferred and external user/business outcomes remain explicitly unknown.

limitations: does not prove unreleased macOS CI
does not prove real-project creative quality
does not replace full assistive-technology testing
public repository metrics are not user value, retention or revenue evidence

questions.note: The documented primary job is an agent-assisted local path from script or footage to a reviewable candidate; external interview validation is unknown.
Repository capability is verified; outcome evidence remains unknown.
Agent-first, local, evidence-bound workflow is distinct from a browser general NLE.
No validated monetization or unit-economic evidence exists; no claim is made.
First verified candidate and creator time-to-value are proposed as measurable product outcomes.
The recommended scope preserves the creator-workflow wedge instead of cloning a full NLE.

findings.statement: The official curl-to-bash installation command exits 2 before dry-run because a stdin script has no repository-relative release-channel file.

impact.user: new users cannot activate the product through the primary public path
impact.business: public acquisition converts to an immediate failure

findings.rootCause: the installer made config/release-channels.json mandatory without a standalone bootstrap path and reads BASH_SOURCE under set -u
findings.currentState: checkout execution works; piped execution fails
findings.targetState: checkout and piped execution resolve the same validated channel contract

findings.statement: The scheduled macOS smoke workflow fails during dependency setup and never reaches Kacha tests.

impact.operations: native compatibility regressions are not observed
impact.release: a required target-environment signal is red

findings.rootCause: pip --user is incompatible with the current externally-managed Homebrew Python runner
findings.targetState: an isolated venv supplies Pillow and fonttools and the workflow reaches all smoke gates

findings.statement: Every Studio bootstrap request spends 8.5 to 11.6 seconds rebuilding the immutable production catalog while static responses take about 1 ms.

impact.user: Studio appears hung during entry and refresh
impact.engineering: synchronous validation serializes local HTTP work

findings.rootCause: the 18 MB motion contract registry and other immutable catalogs are reread and revalidated on every call
findings.targetState: immutable core is validated once, custom styles stay live, and the server prewarms before announcing readiness

findings.statement: Oversized Studio JSON bodies destroy the connection and arrays or null may cross the parser boundary as request bodies.

impact.user: clients receive a reset instead of a stable JSON error
impact.security: route handlers do not receive a guaranteed plain-object contract

findings.rootCause: readRequestBody mixes byte enforcement, socket destruction and JSON parsing without typed HTTP errors
findings.currentState: overflow rejects and destroys; expected errors map to 400
findings.targetState: declared and streamed overflow return JSON 413, non-object roots return 400, and the server remains healthy

findings.statement: Current public product surfaces disagree on regression and catalog counts.
findings.rootCause: derived current values are duplicated without a machine-checkable product-truth contract
findings.currentState: 159 discovered checks versus 154 and 146 claims; English catalog counts are also stale
findings.targetState: one checker derives current values and fails static validation when canonical current surfaces drift

findings.statement: The English official-site route renders an html root language of zh-CN.

impact.accessibility: screen readers and language-aware tools receive the wrong page-level default
impact.seo: the document language does not match the route

findings.rootCause: a shared root layout hard-codes zh-CN while only the content container overrides en
findings.currentState: English subtree is marked en but the document root is zh-CN
findings.targetState: each locale has a static root layout with the correct html lang

findings.statement: The official site silently installs canary/main while stable remains 43 commits behind at v1.1.0.

impact.user: new users cannot make an informed stability choice
impact.support: website capability claims may not exist in stable

findings.rootCause: the default channel is implicit in the command and the adjacent copy does not explain the release boundary
findings.targetState: primary command explicitly names canary and copy offers a truthful stable alternative

findings.statement: There is no current evidence for activation, first-candidate success, retention, time saved, revenue or support cost.

impact.product: roadmap prioritization cannot be tied to user outcomes
impact.operations: improvement claims risk becoming repository-only proxies

findings.rootCause: no privacy-conscious adoption measurement contract or cohort review cadence is documented
findings.currentState: only GitHub traffic and engineering checks are observed
findings.targetState: a local-first measurement dictionary and manual cohort protocol distinguish engineering, activation and human outcome evidence

findings.statement: The website development toolchain reports two high-severity advisories through vinext and image-size, while production dependencies report zero.

impact.security: malicious development-only image inputs could expose a denial-of-service parser path
impact.delivery: the only offered upgrade is a semver-major beta

findings.rootCause: the current vinext line pins a vulnerable transitive parser and no non-breaking fix is offered
findings.currentState: exact advisory exceptions are gated and production exposure is zero
findings.targetState: upgrade only after beta compatibility is proven, or when a stable fixed line is available

findings.statement: Kacha has coherent local-first workflow boundaries, consistent responsive Studio surfaces, 159 passing regression checks and strong loopback/security controls.

impact.product: a credible foundation exists for focused creator workflow differentiation

findings.rootCause: canonical IR, explicit gates, shared kernels and evidence artifacts are treated as product contracts

findings.statement: Kacha can differentiate more credibly by owning the agent-first, evidence-bound creator workflow than by matching OpenCut or OpenMontage feature breadth.

impact.strategy: focuses limited engineering on time-to-first-candidate, recoverability and creator-specific quality

findings.rootCause: competitors already have much broader general editing scope and communities
findings.currentState: the product mostly follows this wedge but does not yet measure it
findings.targetState: roadmap, documentation and outcome metrics reinforce the focused wedge

recommendations.title: Repair the macOS native smoke environment
recommendations.problemOrOpportunity: macOS compatibility has no green scheduled signal.
recommendations.targetState: The workflow installs Python dependencies in an isolated venv and reaches static, core and installer checks.
solutionSteps: create a runner-temp Python venv
install Pillow and fonttools inside it
prepend its bin directory for later script invocations
dispatch the workflow after push and record the run
tradeoffs: the workflow adds venv setup time
recommendations.priorityRationale: A deterministic workflow setup failure blocks all native validation.
acceptanceCriteria: dependency setup succeeds on macos-latest
static and core checks run
installer test runs
rollback: restore workflow and mark native signal unavailable

recommendations.title: Make release-channel choice explicit at acquisition
recommendations.problemOrOpportunity: New users receive canary without an explicit stability decision.
recommendations.targetState: The primary command names canary and adjacent copy explains stable and canary truthfully.
solutionSteps: add --channel canary to the primary command
show a stable alternative in documentation
state that stable remains v1.1.0 until a formal tag
test rendered install copy
alternatives: change the installer default to stable
create a new release in this iteration
tradeoffs: the primary command is slightly longer
recommendations.priorityRationale: Clear channel truth prevents expectation mismatch without creating an unauthorized release.
acceptanceCriteria: website command includes --channel canary
stable alternative is documented
no claim says stable contains current main-only features
rollback: restore prior copy while retaining explicit installer CLI documentation
risks: users may prefer stable and see a smaller feature set

recommendations.title: Restore a secure standalone installer bootstrap
recommendations.problemOrOpportunity: The primary public activation path is broken.
recommendations.targetState: Piped and checkout installs resolve the same validated release-channel source and never silently overwrite an install.
solutionSteps: guard BASH_SOURCE under set -u
prefer the repository-local channel file
fetch the authoritative raw channel JSON only when standalone
validate schema and refs before use
add a mocked pipe execution regression and failure cases
alternatives: hard-code stable and canary refs inside install.sh
replace the public command with a git clone workflow
tradeoffs: standalone dry-run now needs a small HTTPS config fetch
recommendations.priorityRationale: A verified high-impact activation failure with a bounded fix.
acceptanceCriteria: official pipe command dry-runs stable and canary
checkout execution still uses local config
invalid or unavailable config fails closed
existing install no-overwrite behavior remains
rollout: install reviewed local bundle to both agents
rollback: restore the prior installer and use checkout-only installation while documenting the outage
assumptions: the official raw repository remains the channel authority

recommendations.title: Create a machine-checked current product truth contract
recommendations.problemOrOpportunity: Current capability values drift across public and internal surfaces.
recommendations.targetState: Static validation derives current counts and rejects stale canonical claims.
solutionSteps: add a current product-truth verifier
derive test, template, design and resource counts
update Chinese, English, website and canonical product docs
wire the verifier into check-static
limit checks to explicitly current surfaces so historical snapshots stay immutable
alternatives: manually update prose after each iteration
remove all counts from public surfaces
tradeoffs: intentional current count changes require synchronized docs
recommendations.priorityRationale: Small automation prevents recurring public trust drift.
acceptanceCriteria: checker derives 159, 65, 69 and 23
all current canonical surfaces agree
a fixture or mutation proves drift fails
historical snapshot docs are not rewritten
rollout: run website build and rendered tests
let Pages deploy from the pushed website change
rollback: remove checker from static gate and restore prior copy
assumptions: current markers can be explicit and stable

recommendations.title: Make Studio request-body failures typed and recoverable
recommendations.problemOrOpportunity: Malformed and oversized requests do not have a stable HTTP contract.
recommendations.targetState: The parser guarantees a plain object, returns JSON 400 or 413 and keeps the local server healthy.
solutionSteps: introduce status-bearing request errors
precheck Content-Length
enforce streamed byte length without destroying the socket
reject null and array roots
set bounded header and request timeouts
add integration assertions including post-error health
tradeoffs: oversized bodies are drained but not stored before response completion
recommendations.priorityRationale: A local-only surface still needs deterministic fail-closed boundaries.
acceptanceCriteria: declared and chunked overflow return JSON 413
null and array roots return JSON 400
valid route still works after each rejection
rollback: restore parser while keeping loopback controls
assumptions: 1 MB remains sufficient for current Studio mutations

recommendations.title: Define a privacy-conscious adoption measurement loop
recommendations.problemOrOpportunity: Engineering output is not connected to user outcome evidence.
recommendations.targetState: Canonical product docs define activation, candidate success, time saved and retention without silently adding external tracking.
solutionSteps: document an event and metric dictionary
separate local opt-in evidence from public repository traffic
define a small human-reviewed cohort protocol
set decision thresholds and review cadence
keep external analytics provider selection open
alternatives: install a third-party analytics SDK now
use GitHub stars as the north star
tradeoffs: manual cohorts scale slowly but protect privacy and evidence quality
recommendations.priorityRationale: The product needs outcome evidence before expanding feature breadth or making efficiency claims.
acceptanceCriteria: metric definitions distinguish engineering, activation and outcome layers
no third-party tracking is added
cohort review requires human evidence
unknown baselines remain explicit
rollout: collect only user-authorized evidence in future cohorts
rollback: retire the metric proposal without deleting historical evidence
assumptions: future users can opt in to evidence collection

recommendations.title: Cache and prewarm the immutable Studio catalog
recommendations.problemOrOpportunity: Studio entry repeatedly blocks on immutable catalog validation.
recommendations.targetState: Immutable catalog data is validated once per process, custom styles remain live and the server announces readiness only after prewarm.
solutionSteps: separate immutable catalog construction from custom-style merge
cache a private immutable base
clone returned data to prevent shared mutation
prewarm before listen
extend regression to prove custom styles remain visible
alternatives: move validation to an asynchronous worker
tradeoffs: source catalog edits require a Studio process restart
first process startup still pays validation once
recommendations.priorityRationale: A repeatable 8 to 12 second core-journey delay with a safe immutable-cache boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: second catalog load avoids registry revalidation
custom style created after warmup is returned
first HTTP bootstrap after readiness is sub-second on the audit host
catalog digest semantics stay deterministic
rollback: remove cache and prewarm while retaining correctness tests
risks: unexpected expectation of live built-in config reload
assumptions: built-in catalog files are immutable for a running Studio process

recommendations.title: Give each website locale the correct document language
recommendations.problemOrOpportunity: The English page has the wrong root language.
recommendations.targetState: Static Chinese and English route trees render zh-CN and en at the html root.
solutionSteps: use locale-specific route-group root layouts
share metadata constants without nesting html roots
extend rendered HTML tests
verify both routes in Chromium
alternatives: retain only a subtree lang override
tradeoffs: route files move into groups while public URLs stay unchanged
recommendations.priorityRationale: A standards-level accessibility fix with a testable static result.
acceptanceCriteria: Chinese rendered html is zh-CN
English rendered html is en
routes and canonical URLs remain unchanged
no narrow-screen overflow or console errors
rollback: restore shared layout and retain subtree language override
assumptions: current Next-compatible build supports multiple root layouts

recommendations.title: Re-evaluate the vinext development advisory on a stable upgrade line
recommendations.problemOrOpportunity: The current toolchain has development-only high advisories with only a major beta fix.
recommendations.targetState: Advisories are removed without destabilizing the official-site build.
solutionSteps: track a stable fixed vinext line
test beta only in an isolated branch
retain exact advisory gating and production-zero requirement
upgrade after build and Pages parity pass
recommendations.priorityRationale: Production exposure is zero and the available fix is a major beta, so forced migration is disproportionate.
acceptanceCriteria: production audit remains zero
exact dev exceptions do not broaden
future fixed upgrade passes lint, types, builds and Pages tests
rollback: restore current exact versions and advisory gate
risks: advisory remains in local development tooling
assumptions: untrusted ICNS, JXL and HEIF inputs are not fed to the website build
